notes.title: Statement for the latest Update of Flag Clicker
notes.content:
Dear Players,



We want to sincerely apologize for the frustration and disappointment caused by the recent update to Flag Clicker, particularly regarding the changes to the achievement system. We understand how important achievements are to many of you, especially those who have spent significant time and effort working toward them.



Unfortunately, our decision to adjust the achievements led to the loss of progress for many collectors, and for that, we are truly sorry. We’ve also heard accusations of scam-like behavior and claims that we made these changes solely for financial gain. We want to be transparent: this is not the case. As of now, Steam has not paid us a single euro for our work on the game, and we are actually €180 in the negative.



Moving forward, we are committed to improving our communication with you. Before making significant changes to the achievement system or other major aspects of the game, we will ensure to inform you early and seek your input. Your feedback is invaluable to us and will help shape the future of the game.



Regarding our plans, we’ve already applied to Steam to increase the achievement limit, and we’re working on exciting updates such as adding music to the game and introducing a crafting system. We’re passionate about continuing to develop Flag Clicker and want it to be an enjoyable experience for everyone.



Once again, we deeply regret the impact this update has had on our community. We are learning from this experience and are determined to do better. Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support.



Sincerely,

The Flag Clicker Development Team

notes.title: Developer Update: Changes to the Achievement System
notes.content:
Developer Update: Changes to the Achievement System

Hello everyone,


today, we want to talk about a significant update for our achievement system. After much internal discussion, we’ve decided it’s time to overhaul the system entirely.


Our goal is to make achievements more meaningful, rewarding, and engaging for all players. This means that every single achievement in the game will be reviewed, adjusted, or reimagined. Some achievements may be retired, while new ones will be introduced to better reflect the way the game has grown and evolved over time. 


We understand that achievements hold a special place for many of you—they represent dedication, skill, and personal milestones. We value your input and want to hear your thoughts, suggestions, and even concerns about this update. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, and it will help us shape a system that feels fair, fun, and exciting for everyone.


Over the next few days we will be hosting opportunities for direct feedback from the community. Please keep an eye on our channels for updates, and don’t hesitate to share your ideas in the comments or through our feedback forms.


Thank you for being such a passionate and supportive community. We’re confident that, with your help, we can create something truly special together.



—The Flag Clicker Development Team

notes.title: FLAG CLICKER - v0.0.2.1 [Hotfix]
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to present an update that enhances your gaming experience. We are continually working to improve gameplay and interface elements to ensure your time in our game is as enjoyable and seamless as possible. In this patch, we have addressed several bugs and optimized various features for a smoother experience. Please find the complete list of fixes below:

Options Menu

 Improved interface adaptability in options. Now elements are positioned correctly at any resolution.
 The option to disable the main menu animation has been removed.
 Fixed background offset in the settings menu at resolutions other than 16:9.


Inventory Menu

 Fixed background offset in the inventory menu at resolutions other than 16:9.
 Improved interface adaptability in the inventory. Now elements are positioned correctly at any resolution.


Game Scene

 Fixed the issue where thousands, millions, etc. were not separated in the score counter.
 Fixed a critical bug with score saving during scene transitions. Everything now works correctly.


Authors Menu

 The authors menu is now wider at resolutions other than 16:9.
 In the authors menu, text does not overlap at resolutions other than 16:9.
 Fixed the issue where the close button of the authors menu was misaligned.
 The authors menu now fully covers the game screen.
 Fixed a typo in the word "Deutsch" in the authors menu.


Flags

 Changed description of PRC


Your Flag Clicker Team.

notes.title: Devblog: Release Announcement for Flag Clicker
notes.content:
Hello Flag Clicker Community!

We are excited to announce that our game Flag Clicker will officially launch into Early Access on 
June 15, 2024! We are incredibly grateful for your support and patience throughout the development phase and can’t wait to share the finished game with you.

Continuous Improvements and Bug Fixes

Since the beginning of development, we have taken your feedback very seriously and have continuously worked to improve the gaming experience. Our team is dedicated to fixing known bugs and optimizing the game. Even after the launch, we will provide regular updates to ensure that Flag Clicker offers a smooth and exciting gaming experience. Your feedback is invaluable to us!

Exclusive Closed Beta Flag

A special thanks goes to our Closed Beta testers. You have played a crucial role in shaping Flag Clicker into what it is today. As a token of our appreciation, we have included the exclusive Closed Beta Flag in the game. However, this special flag will only be available in the drop pool until the launch. After that, it will no longer be obtainable. So, make sure to grab it while you still can!

We are counting down the days until the launch and look forward to sharing the full Flag Clicker experience with you on June 15, 2024. Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being part of this exciting journey!



The Flag Clicker Development Team

notes.title: Shop Release
notes.content:
Devblog: Our Store Page is Finally Live!
        
Hello everyone!

        
We are incredibly excited to announce that the store page for our game Flag Clicker is now officially live on Steam! ????

        
Yes, you read that right – after months of hard work and countless hours of testing and refining, we are proud to finally present our project in all its glory.

        
             
        
        Why Are We So Excited?
        
The launch of our store page is a significant milestone on our journey. It’s not just a step closer to the release of the game but also an opportunity for us to gather feedback from you, our community. We are eager to hear your reactions, suggestions, and of course, your support!

        
        How Can You Support Us?
        
            Wishlist: Add Flag Clicker to your wishlist on Steam to help us gain visibility and stay updated.
            Share: Tell your friends and share about Flag Clicker on social media. The more people know about our game, the better!
            Feedback: Visit our store page, try out the demo (if available), and let us know your thoughts and suggestions in the comments.
        
        
        
Here is the link to the store page: Flag Clicker on Steam

We want to thank each and every one of you who has supported us on this journey. Without your enthusiasm and encouragement, none of this would be possible. We can’t wait to show you more of Flag Clicker and dive into the world of flags together.

        
        
Thank you and see you soon in the game!
